title: Polynomial-time bounded replication
statement: Let $C_w,c\in\mathbb{N}$ and fix $b\in\{0,1\}$. For a bit string $z$, apply the total first projection twice to obtain a bit string $x$ (each projection returns the empty word when its input does not parse as a pair). Then output the constant word consisting of $b$ repeated $C_w(|x|+1)^c$ times. This function of $z$ is polynomial-time computable.
